notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Great Whale
When Eternal Witness and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
